page.notes: Faint stray marks in the left margin (around lines 9–14 and 21–23) and at the right edge are stains or show-through, not printed notes; not transcribed. Line 29 "vicissim" is printed with a damaged letter pattern, so it is marked as doubtful. The catchword is cut off at the page edge; "ipse" is a reading of the visible strokes. Printed spellings such as "converso", "Euangelio" and "irrisero" are copied from the scan, with u/v normalised.
